About EY
EY is a global leader operating in over 150 countries, delivering exceptional services in Consulting and helping clients transform and enhance their capabilities. We are committed to building a better working world by creating long-term value for clients, people, and society, while fostering trust in capital markets.
This commitment is reflected in a culture that emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and flexibility—empowering you to make a real impact. At EY, your career is yours to shape, supported by a global network, an inclusive culture, and advanced technology. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to bring your ideas to help us grow even further.
The Opportunity
As an AI Software Engineer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and delivering AI-enabled applications for our clients. You will take full ownership of solutions from development through production, working across the full software lifecycle. This role sits in a high-growth area with strong visibility and exposure to cutting-edge AI and engineering practices.
Your Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain full-stack applications using React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Python (FastAPI)
Take end-to-end ownership of application delivery, from design and development to deployment and production support
Design and build scalable backend services and APIs
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into business applications
Apply strong DevOps practices , including CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployment, monitoring, and automation
Actively use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to improve productivity and code quality
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Strong experience in full-stack software development
Hands-on expertise with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Python/FastAPI
Proven experience managing applications across the full software development lifecycle
Strong understanding of DevOps principles and cloud-native development
Experience using AI coding tools in daily development workflows
Excellent problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset
What We Look For
We are looking for passionate engineers who are curious, adaptable, and excited about building AI-driven solutions. If you enjoy taking ownership, working with modern technology, and helping organizations transform through AI, this role is for you.
What We Offer
Continuous Learning: Develop future-ready skills through ongoing training and real-world experience
Success as Defined by You: Flexibility and tools to make a meaningful impact in your own way
Transformative Leadership: Coaching and support to help you grow as a leader
Diverse & Inclusive Culture: An environment where your individuality is valued and your voice is heard

The Software Engineering Director for AI Tooling plays a pivotal role in translating strategy into execution—designing and scaling modern software platforms, AIenabled tools, and internal products that create measurable value for Fortune 500 and growthstage clients alike.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering excellence, applied AI, and business impact—partnering closely with executives, product leaders, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver systems that can be adopted, trusted, and scaled.
Your key responsibilities
As a Software Engineering Director, you will lead the design and delivery of productiongrade software systems and AIenabled tooling that underpin highvisibility client engagements and internal platforms. You will own architectural decisions, development standards, and technical direction across multiple workstreams.
Key responsibilities include:
Architect, build, and scale core software platforms that integrate data, AI services, and userfacing applications.
Lead the development of AIpowered tools, including decision support systems, copilots, internal developer tools, and domainspecific agents.
Design and maintain robust service architectures (APIs, eventdriven systems, batch and realtime pipelines) optimized for reliability, security, and extensibility.
Establish engineering best practices across code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to productionize models and agents, ensuring seamless integration into realworld workflows.
Partner directly with business leaders and Csuite executives to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Successful candidates will bring strong engineering judgment, fluency in modern AI tooling, and the ability to operate comfortably across strategy and execution.
You will be expected to:
Lead development of backend and fullstack systems using modern languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, TypeScript).
Design and manage cloudnative architectures on platforms such as AWS or GCP, using containerization and infrastructureascode.
Build AIready application layers that integrate LLMs, retrieval systems, vector databases, and model orchestration frameworks.
Develop internal tooling and developer platforms that improve velocity, reliability, and reuse across teams.
Define and enforce standards for security, privacy, reliability, and compliance (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA, enterprise governance).
Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete system designs and incremental delivery plans.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 5+ years of professional engineering experience; or A graduate degree and approximately 3+ years of relevant experience.
D emonstrated experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering, or technical leadership roles.
Strong proficiency in modern software development practices, including APIs, distributed systems, and cloud services.
Hands on experience deploying AIenabled applications or tooling into production environments.
Comfort operating in fastpaced, clientfacing environments with evolving requirements.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
Experience working in management consulting, productled organizations, or highgrowth startups.
Familiarity with modern AI ecosystems, including LLM frameworks, agent architectures, and prompt/tool orchestration.
A strong product mindset—understanding not just how to build systems, but how they will be adopted and sustained.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
What we look for
We are looking for candidates who have a strong aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients’ goals.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more .
We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $205,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Government and Infrastructure – Technology Consulting - Cybersecurity – DevSecOps Senior Engineer - Senior Consultant
From strategy to execution, the Government & Infrastructure of Ernst & Young provides a full range of consulting and audit services to help our Federal, State, Local and Education clients implement new ideas to help achieve their mission outcomes. We deliver real change and measurable results through our diverse, high-performing teams, quality work at the highest professional standards, operational know-how from across our global organization, and creative and bold ideas that drive innovation. We enable our government clients to achieve their mission of protecting the nation and serving the people; increasing public safety; improving healthcare for our military, veterans and citizens; delivering essential public services; and helping those in need. EY is ready to help our government build a better working world.
The opportunity
Our cybersecurity professionals possess diverse industry knowledge, along with unique technical expertise and specialized skills. The team works together in planning, pursuing, delivering and managing engagements to assess, improve, build, and in some cases operate integrated security operations for our clients.
We will support you with career-long training and coaching to develop your skills. As EY is a global leading service provider in this space, you will be working with the best of the best in a collaborative environment. So, whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
Your key responsibilities
Our cybersecurity professionals possess diverse industry knowledge, along with unique technical expertise and specialized skills. The team stays highly relevant by researching and discovering the newest security vulnerabilities, attending and speaking at top security conferences around the world, and sharing knowledge on a variety of cybersecurity topics with key industry groups.
The DevSecOps Senior Engineer assesses the delivery and security maturity of each application in the portfolio and builds the secure pipelines, controls and automated evidence that the modernization factory runs on. This role ensures that security is built into how software is delivered — not added afterwards — and that rationalization recommendations reflect each application's true security posture and delivery risk.
· Assess each application's delivery toolchain and practices — source control, build and release automation (for example, Jenkins and Bitbucket), artifact management (Artifactory), code quality (SonarQube), Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible) and monitoring (Datadog) — and identify manual release processes and gaps.

· Design, build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines for the modernization factory with integrated static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis, container image scanning, Infrastructure-as-Code scanning, secrets detection and quality gates.

You will help our clients navigate the complex world of modern data science, analytics, and software engineering. We'll look to you to provide guidance and perform technical development tasks to ensure AI solutions are responsibly engineered, evaluated, deployed, and maintained to support the ongoing business needs of our clients.

Researching and implementing scalable machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems that meet business requirements
Building data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions on Databricks
Evaluating, monitoring, and optimizing learning processes on Databricks to improve high-performance models, with tools like MLflow evaluation and tracing
Designing, building, and governing domain ontologies and semantic models that define business concepts, relationships, and rules for AI solutions, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data products
This position may have travel requirements as needed to engage with external clients regularly
Skills and attributes for success
To excel in this role, you will need a blend of technical expertise and interpersonal skills. Your ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver impactful solutions will be essential.
This role will work to deliver tech at speed, innovate at scale and put humans at the center. Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with team members with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services focusing on more complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues surrounding emerging technology. Demonstrate technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Learn about EY and its service lines and actively assess and present ways to apply knowledge and services.
Translating AI strategy into a implementable Model Engineering activities that aligns with the client’s goals, mission and vision
Working with teams of AI engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to deliver production-grade data engineering pipelines and AI solutions—including machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI—for clients on Databricks
Implementing product-centric AI solutions on Databricks, from discovery and roadmap definition through iterative delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable business and user outcomes
Working across design, build, deploy, and operate phases to deliver production-grade data and AI pipelines, including governed business ontologies and semantic models on Databricks, so solutions remain reliable, reusable, and aligned with client business processes
Applying a product-centric development approach to data and AI solutions by defining user outcomes, prioritizing reusable capabilities, managing roadmaps and backlogs, incorporating user feedback, measuring adoption and business value, and continuously improving products after launch
Staying abreast of AI technology trends and provide directional guidance and recommendations around AIOps, MLOps, and AgentOps tools and solutions on Databricks that fit their needs and integrate with their existing ecosystem
Applying combined business and technical knowledge to develop and execute ModelOps target architecture on Databricks that enables implementation and monitoring of AI at scale, with tools like Unity Catalog and Model Serving
Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Platform Engineers, DevOps to implement and sustain solutions in the Databricks platform
Understanding clients’ overall data, AI and technology landscape and business priorities and success measures
Strong team collaboration and experience working with a diverse team in a hybrid model (on site and remote)
Working on large-scale client engagements. Fostering relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently delivering quality client services. Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
Collaborating, influencing and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making

A Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree).
3-6 years of full-time working experience in AI and/or Machine Learning
Databricks Certification with a minimum of 1 professional and 1 associate certification that includes a combination of Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Strong skills in Python, PySpark, and/or Scala
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with diverse, hybrid, and global teams.
Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-impact, high-value production AI/ML solutions on a major cloud platform using Databricks
At least two years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions on Databricks, including experience with Agent Bricks, Model Serving, or Lakeflow Jobs.
Delivered models or agents to production on Databricks, with tracking, evaluation, and monitoring.
Proficient in foundation models, generative AI, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)) and experienced with ML packages like scikit-learn and PyTorch, using Databricks tools including Agent Bricks, AI Search, Foundation Model APIs, and Unity Gateway
Experience with natural language processing and deep learning
Extensive experience in DevOps tools (Git, Azure DevOps) and AI-driven SDLC for developing, deploying, and scaling analytical solutions on Databricks, for example with Databricks Git folders, Declarative Automation Bundles, and the Databricks CLI and SDKs
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps and ML workflows on Databricks, including data ingestion, transformation, and evaluation, for example with MLflow, Models in Unity Catalog, and Model Serving
Experience with model retraining and feedback loop methodologies on Databricks, for example with Lakeflow Jobs and Databricks Feature Store
Experience evaluating and operating models and AI solutions on Databricks, including observability, monitoring, reporting, MLflow evaluation and tracing, and data quality monitoring.
Understanding of data structures, Responsible AI practices, and data modelling, and software engineering best practices
Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and operations research, with proficiency in data manipulation tools (SQL, Pandas, Spark) and deep learning techniques, using Databricks tools such as Databricks SQL and Delta Lake, using Databricks tools such as Databricks SQL and Delta Lake.
Excellent communication skills for conveying findings and recommendations, with willingness to travel as needed for client engagements.

A track record of working with diverse teams to drive outcomes through complex problem-solving of working with diverse teams to drive outcomes through complex problem-solving
Knowledge of sustainability practices in technology
A deep understanding of and ability to teach concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches to apply them
Experience fine-tuning Generative AI models on Databricks, including with AI Runtime (serverless GPU)
Experience with image processing techniques and/or speech and audio processing and analysis

We seek individuals who are not only technically proficient but also possess the qualities of a top performer. You should be innovative, adaptable, and purpose driven by a desire to make a significant impact in the field of artificial intelligence. You'll need to have a passion for continuous learning, stay ahead of the trends, and influence new ways of working so you can position solutions in the most relevant and innovative way for our clients. You can expect heavy client interaction in a fast-paced environment and the opportunity to develop your own career path for your unique skills and ambitions.
EY is experiencing significant growth in consulting services centered on Databricks, a market-leading data and AI platform. We are seeking an accomplished leader who combines strong business acumen, consulting experience, and technical credibility to help clients realize value from this strategic platform. In this role, you will collaborate with clients and Databricks account, sector, and leadership teams to shape and deliver generative AI use cases, advanced data and AI solutions, and scalable platforms.
In this role, you will research, build, and implement scalable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems that learn, reason, and generate outputs tailored to business requirements on Databricks. You will enhance data pipelines and storage on Databricks, ensuring data is clean, accurate, and optimized for XOps processes. Additionally, you will monitor and evaluate learning processes to continuously improve high-performance models, collaborating with other data and analytics professionals to industrialize analysis into effective analytics solutions. You will deliver solutions on Databricks, from data pipelines to agents in production.
Your key responsibilities
As a Manager in Model Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions that drive business success. You will work with a wide variety of clients to deliver modern AI engineering, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. Your teams will design and build scalable solutions that unify, enrich, and derive insights from varied data sources across a broad technology landscape. You will help our clients navigate the complex world of modern data science, analytics, and software engineering. We'll look to you to provide guidance and perform technical development tasks to ensure AI solutions are responsibly engineered, evaluated, deployed, and maintained to support the ongoing business needs of our clients.
You will be joining a dynamic and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers who love to tackle the most challenging computational problems for our clients. We love to think creatively, build applications efficiently, and collaborate in both the ideation of solutions and the pursuit of new opportunities. Many on our team have advanced academic degrees or equivalent experience in industry.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading AI workstreams from solution design through production deployment and ongoing optimization, focusing on the Databricks platform
Leading teams building data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions on Databricks
Continuously improving processes by identifying innovative solutions through research and analysis
Managing multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex AI engineering initiatives, with accountability for quality, responsible deployment, and results
Engaging actively with clients, participating in daily working sessions, and leading workstreams from planning through execution to closure
Designing, building, and governing domain ontologies and semantic models that define business concepts, relationships, and rules for AI solutions, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data products
Applying a product-centric development approach by partnering with product, business, data science, and engineering stakeholders to define user needs, prioritize reusable capabilities, and iteratively deliver measurable outcomes across the product lifecycle
Identifying opportunities for additional services and managing engagement economics
Skills and attributes for success
To excel in this role, you will need a blend of technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. This role will work to deliver tech at speed, innovate at scale and put humans at the center. Provide technical guidance and share knowledge with team members with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services focusing on more complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues surrounding emerging technology. Demonstrate technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Learn about EY and its service lines and actively assess and present ways to apply knowledge and services
The following attributes will make a significant impact:
Translating AI strategy into a implementable Model Engineering activities that aligns with the client’s goals, mission and vision
Leading teams of AI engineers, data engineers, and data scientists in the delivery of production-grade solutions for clients on Databricks; These include data engineering pipelines, AI solutions (machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI), and the pipelines that support AI solutions
Implementing product-centric AI solutions on Databricks, from discovery and roadmap definition through iterative delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable business and user outcomes.
Working across design, build, deploy, and operate phases to deliver production-grade data and AI pipelines, governed business ontologies, and semantic models on Databricks, ensuring solutions are reliable, reusable, and aligned with client business processes
Experience applying a product-centric development approach to data and AI solutions by defining user outcomes, prioritizing reusable capabilities, managing roadmaps and backlogs, incorporating user feedback, measuring adoption and business value, and continuously improving products after launch
Staying abreast of AI technology trends and provide directional guidance and recommendations around AIOps, MLOps, and AgentOps tools and solutions on Databricks that fit their needs and integrate with their existing ecosystem
Applying combined business and technical knowledge to develop and execute ModelOps target architecture on Databricks that enables implementation and monitoring of AI at scale, with tools like Unity Catalog and Model Serving
Collaborating with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and Platform Engineers, DevOps to implement and sustain solutions in the Databricks platform
Staying abreast of industry trends, technology innovations and AI regulatory requirements across the globe
Understanding clients’ overall data, AI and technology landscape and business priorities and success measures
Strong team collaboration and experience working with a diverse team in a hybrid model (on site and remote)
Fostering relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels
Consistently delivering quality client services
Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
Collaborating, influencing and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making
To qualify for the role, you must have:
A Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree)
6-10 years of relevant experience of full-time working experience in AI, Data Science, and/or Machine Learning
2-4 years of experience directly managing technical teams
3-4 years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML solutions on the Databricks platform, including use of Agent Bricks, Model Serving, or Lakeflow Jobs
Databricks Certification with a minimum of 1 professional and 1 associate certification that includes a combination of Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Strong skills in Python, PySpark, and/or Scala
Ability lead, collaborate, and communicate effectively with diverse, hybrid and global teams
Experience designing, building, and maintaining high-impact, high-value production AI/ML solutions on a major cloud platform, using Databricks
Delivered models or agents to production on Databricks, with tracking, evaluation, and monitoring
Proficient in foundation models, generative AI, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)) and experienced with ML packages like scikit-learn and PyTorch, using Databricks tools including Agent Bricks, AI Search, Foundation Model APIs, and Unity Gateway
Experience with natural language processing and deep learning
Extensive experience in DevOps tools (Git, Azure DevOps), AI-driven SDLC, and CI/CD pipelines for developing, deploying, and scaling analytical solutions on Databricks, for example with Databricks Git folders, Declarative Automation Bundles, and the Databricks CLI and SDKs
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps and ML workflows on Databricks, including data ingestion, transformation, and evaluation, for example with MLflow, Models in Unity Catalog, and Model Serving
Experience with model retraining and feedback loop methodologies on Databricks, for example with Lakeflow Jobs and Databricks Feature Store
Experience with model and solution evaluation, observability, monitoring, and reporting on Databricks, including MLflow evaluation and tracing, and data quality monitoring
Understanding of data structures, data modeling, software engineering, and Responsible AI practices
Experience designing, implementing, validating, and maintaining ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models in collaboration with domain experts
Experience with product-centric development, including translating customer and business needs into product requirements, roadmaps, iterative releases, and measurable adoption or performance outcomes
Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and operations research, with proficiency in data manipulation tools (SQL, Pandas, Spark) and deep learning techniques, using Databricks tools including Databricks SQL and Delta Lake
Excellent communication skills for conveying findings and recommendations, with a willingness to travel for client engagements
Skills in Technical Design Optimization
Strong relationship-building skills
Demonstrated client trust and value
Digital fluency and emotional agility
Commercial acumen and negotiation skills
Proven ability to lead teams and manage change
Ideally, you’ll also have:
A deep understanding of and ability to teach concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches to apply them
Master's degree Computer Science, Mathematics, Physical Sciences, or other quantitative field
Databricks Solution Architect Champion Badge preferred
Experience working with diverse teams to deliver complex solutions
Experience fine-tuning Generative AI models on Databricks, including with AI Runtime (serverless GPU)
Experience in managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
A strong understanding of industry trends and emerging technologies
Skills in data visualization and storytelling with data
Experience with image processing techniques and/or speech and audio processing and analysis
Databricks Certifications in the Data & AI domain, including Data Engineer Associate or Professional, Machine Learning Associate or Professional, Generative AI Engineer Associate, and/or Context Engineering Associate
Experience building data and AI applications on Databricks, including with Databricks Apps or Lakebase Postgres
What we look for
We seek individuals who are not only technically proficient but also possess the ability to think critically and creatively. Top performers demonstrate a commitment to excellence, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for driving innovation in the field of AI and data science. Your ability to collaborate effectively and communicate with clarity will set you apart as a leader in our team.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers .

New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $150,700 to $251,200

EY GDS’s Tax Innovation, Solutions and Technology (IST) group as well as the Tax Tech Transformation (TTT) team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Tax practice, you’ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
The opportunity
EY's GDS IST and TTT team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS IST and TTT team works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking Senior to join our Tax Technology practice.
Your key responsibilities
Apply machine learning techniques to deliver actionable insights
Own end-to-end model development in Python, including data exploration, feature engineering, training, validation, and scoring on structured and unstructured data
Design and build systems that mine massive datasets and structure/ engineer it to be usable for machine learning models and to apply AI/Machine Learning technology to solve real-world problems
Apply standard statistical methods, simulation models and statistical programming as needed
Collaborate closely with business users and analysts to translate requirements into AI/ML solutions and present outcomes clearly
Manage stakeholders and mentor team members in Machine Learning, AI, and best practices
Design and implement Generative AI–enabled solutions such as AI agents, APIs, and intelligent interfaces, integrating with enterprise GenAI platforms (Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry)
Hands-on experience in LLM fine tuning and optimization, including parameter efficient tuning techniques and systematic evaluation of model quality, latency, and cost in production environments
Strong expertise in production grade prompt and GenAI system design, including prompt templating, chaining, RAG pipelines, guardrails, and reliability patterns for scalable enterprise deployments
Skills and attributes for success
An overall experience of 5 + years of which 3+ years of hands-on work experience in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
Strong hands-on experience with ML/AI techniques including regression, decision trees, random forests, classification, clustering, NLP/NLG, deep learning, neural networks, and ARIMA
Proven experience delivering end-to-end ML projects from development to production
Expert proficiency in Python, with strong programming, algorithmic, and database skills
Strong understanding of Generative AI and LLM technologies, including prompt engineering and enterprise LLM integration
To qualify for the role, you must have
Master’s degree in Statistics/Mathematics from a reputed college OR Bachelors / Master’s degree in Science/ Engineering / MCA.
Hands-on involvement across the design, development, testing, and deployment of AI/ML solutions
Tax application experience
Ideally, you’ll also have
Exposure to cloud (Azure, AWS) would be good to have.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY TAS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning : You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Data Scientist, Advanced Technologies (National Tax -Tax Technology and Transformation) (Manager) (Multiple Positions) (1754237), Ernst & Young U.S. LLP, New York, NY.
Apply data mining techniques, performing statistical analysis and building high quantity prediction systems integrated with tax technology products. Assist businesses navigate the digital age of tax transparency alongside new trends in tax compliance and tax audit methods, as well as helping to solve the most pressing challenges that businesses face. Identify complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options, and provide data-driven business recommendations to clients. Decrease the cost of managing data and increasing the value of existing data. Process, cleanse and verify the integrity of data used for analysis and enhance data collection procedures to include information that is relevant for building analytic system. Select features and, build and optimize classifiers using machine learning techniques. Support various client projects, ranging from assisting in the production of leading edge machine models, to designing and implementing robust data pipelines that can handle data at a multinational, enterprise scale.
Manage and motivate teams of professionals with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services by monitoring progress. Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.
Full time employment, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30 am – 5:30 pm.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field and 5 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate related work experience. Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field and 3 years of related work experience.
Must have 3 years of experience working in a professional services firm, a consulting firm, or a mid-sized/regional to large-sized/national public accounting firm.
Must have 3 years of experience in the management and manipulation of large datasets, both structured and unstructured, of which 1 year of experience must be with tax or accounting-related datasets.
Must have 3 years of experience with machine learning techniques and algorithms, including at least one of the following: Linear/Logistic Regression, k-NN, Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and/or Decision Forests.
Must have 2 years of experience managing and/or analyzing data using at least one of the following:
- SQL and NoSQL;
- SQL Server; or
- MongoDB.
Must have 1 year of experience with using the Python toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, and/or Jupyter Notebooks).
Must have 1 year of experience with distributed file systems including Apache Spark.
Must have 1 year of experience designing and implementing ETL solutions for tools, including at least one of the following: Alteryx, SSIS, DataStage, Informatica, Talend, and/or Pentaho.
Must have 1 year of experience with data visualization tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, and/or D3.js.
Must have 1 year of experience with data science programming languages, including, Python and R.
Must have 1 year of experience managing junior data and data analytics professionals, including setting goals, assigning work, and reviewing performance.
Must hold at least one of the following certification/accreditation or the ability to obtain within 1 year of hire: Certified Digital Product Manager (CDPM); Certified Product Manager (CPM); Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, information systems, engineering, or Quantitative Economics; Certified Member of the Institute for Professionals in Taxation (CMI); Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) or foreign equivalent; Certified SAFe Professional; Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA); Vertex Certified Implementer; Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Certified Implementer Program (CIP); Microsoft Azure or Azure AI; Microsoft Power Platform or Devops Engineer.
Requires domestic travel up to 10%, to serve client needs.
Employer will accept any suitable combination of education, training, or experience.

As AI Engineer, you will design and build production-grade AI and agentic AI solutions that solve real business problems for EY's clients. You are the core builder on the delivery team, responsible for AI/ML pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-agent coordination, evaluation frameworks, observability and governance that ensure AI solutions work in production.
The opportunity
You will work across complex client engagements designing and implementing AI/ML and agentic AI solutions end to end. You will work closely with business stakeholders, AI Architect, AI Platform Engineers, and Data Scientists to translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and responsible AI solutions through maintainable architectural. You will have the opportunity to influence executive stakeholders and help clients responsibly adopt agentic AI to drive measurable business outcomes.
This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.
Your key responsibilities
Design and implement production-grade agentic AI workflows using open frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, proprietary cloud-based agentic platforms, including agent orchestration, AI gateways (i.e. MCP, A2A), observability, controls and guardrails.
Build and optimise retrieval pipelines for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows, including chunking strategies, embedding models, vector store integration, and re-ranking to ground agent outputs in accurate, current enterprise data.
Develop and integrate Generative/Agentic AI solutions using large and small language models (LLMs and SLMs).
Build evaluation frameworks to measure AI solution quality, consistency, and implement telemetry and monitoring to track model drift, latency, output quality, and cost metrics in production.
Leverage machine learning/deep learning algorithms and foundational statistical concepts to solve real-world AI/ML problems at scale
Implement best practices for MLOps, LLMOps, across experimental and production environments, including AI pipeline and microservices deployment into cloud environments, APIs, CI/CD, ensuring high availability and low latency.
Build AI governance and responsible AI controls for AI systems
Mentor junior team members and contribute to EY AI assets, accelerators, delivery standards, and go-to-market offerings in AI/ML, agentic and generative AI
Skills and attributes for success
Deep experience designing and building agentic AI systems in enterprise environments.
Analytical mindset to troubleshoot AI-specific failure modes, model hallucinations, retrieval gaps, context overflow, agent looping, and system latency and engineer reliable solutions around them.
Experience with AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory considerations in complex or regulated industries.
Adapts quickly to fast-moving environments with frequent updates in AI frameworks, agentic tool patterns, LLM capabilities, and cloud platform services
To qualify for the role, you must have
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or related technical discipline (MSc/PhD is an advantage).
3-8+ years of AI development experience, with at least 2 years focused on building and maintaining production grade AI/ML or agentic AI solutions.
Hands-on experience in developing machine learning and deep learning algorithms at scale
Deep experience working with AI/ML libraries and frameworks
Understanding of foundational statistics and mathematical modeling
Advanced object-oriented coding skills in Python for production-level codebases. Familiarity with Java, TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus.
Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents and AI/ML solutions.
Hands-on experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and version control for AI systems; working knowledge of LLM observability and monitoring tools.
Experience in API integration and development.
Consulting or professional services experience is strongly preferred.
What we look for
We’re interested in passionate leaders with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the IT Advisory space. If you have a strong passion for helping businesses achieve their IT strategy, this role is for you.
What we offer
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 15 days of vacation plus ten observed holidays and three paid personal days, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:
The opportunity to manage a portfolio of talent within a designated service line
A collaborative environment where everyone works together to create a better working world
Excellent training and development prospects, both through established programs and on-the-job training
An excellent team of senior colleagues, dedicated to managing and varying your workload

Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.
Salary Ranges: $88,000 – $132,000

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. EY is a global leader operating in over 150 countries, delivering exceptional services in Consulting and helping clients transform and strengthen their capabilities. We are committed to building a better working world by creating long-term value for clients, people, and society, while fostering trust in capital markets.
This commitment begins with a culture that emphasizes learning, growth opportunities, and innovation—empowering you to make a meaningful impact. At EY, your career is yours to shape, supported by a global network, inclusive culture, and advanced technology. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to bring your voice to help us continuously improve.
The Opportunity
As an AI Data Engineer , you will play a key role in enabling clients to modernize their data platforms and unlock the value of AI-driven insights. You will work on cutting-edge technologies to design and build scalable, intelligent data solutions, particularly focused on next-generation, AI-driven (agentic) data pipelines beyond traditional ETL approaches.
This is a high-growth area within EY, offering strong exposure to innovative projects, emerging technologies, and career advancement opportunities.
Your Key Responsibilities
Design and build scalable, AI-driven/agentic data pipelines for advanced analytics and machine learning use cases
Work hands-on with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Spark, Kafka, and Airflow
Develop and optimize data processing workflows, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
Ensure data quality, governance, and integrity across the data lifecycle
(Optional/Bonus) Contribute to solution architecture, proposals, and RFP responses in consulting engagements
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Proven experience as a Data Engineer or AI Data Engineer
Hands-on experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Spark, Kafka, and Airflow
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, Scala )
Solid understanding of modern data architecture and AI-driven data pipelines
Experience in cloud environments (preferably Microsoft Azure )
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
What We Look For
We are looking for passionate and forward-thinking individuals who are excited about AI-driven data transformation. If you are curious, adaptable, and motivated to help organizations unlock the power of data and AI, this role is for you.

Continuous Learning: Build future-ready skills through ongoing development and training
Success as Defined by You: Flexibility and tools to create meaningful impact in your own way

(6+ Years Experience)
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity
An opportunity to combine Data Science, AI/ML, and pharmaceutical domain expertise to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that transform manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business operations.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, validate, and deploy data science, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions to address pharmaceutical business and manufacturing challenges.
Analyse large, complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and actionable insights.
Develop predictive and prescriptive models, forecasting solutions, optimization models, and statistical analyses.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, validation, and performance monitoring.
Collaborate with pharma business, manufacturing, quality, engineering, IT, data engineering, and subject-matter experts to translate business problems into analytical solutions.
Develop analytics solutions for areas such as manufacturing performance, process optimization, quality, deviation analysis, predictive maintenance, supply chain, and operational excellence, depending on project requirements.
Build reusable analytical pipelines and work with data engineering teams to establish reliable data pipelines and datasets.
Apply appropriate AI/ML techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, clustering, classification, regression, and optimization.
Evaluate opportunities for Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) where appropriate to the business use case.
Develop dashboards, visualizations, and data-driven insights to support operational and management decision-making.
Support deployment and operationalization of models through appropriate MLOps, versioning, monitoring, testing, and model governance practices. Production ML roles commonly include model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and troubleshooting.
Ensure solutions involving regulated data follow applicable data governance, security, privacy, validation, and regulatory requirements.
Clearly communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Perform technical reviews and provide guidance to junior data scientists and analytics team members.
Qualifications
6+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, Advanced Analytics, or related areas.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience applying data science within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences domain.
Strong hands-on experience developing statistical and machine-learning models using real-world datasets.
Strong programming experience with Python and SQL; experience with R and/or SAS is an advantage. Current pharma/healthcare data science roles commonly seek programming and statistical/data-science expertise.
Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets and performing data preparation, feature engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation.
Understanding of pharmaceutical processes and regulated data environments.
Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary business, scientific, engineering, and technology teams.
Experience taking data-science solutions from proof of concept through production deployment is preferred.
Experience with pharmaceutical manufacturing/MES data, process data, quality data, laboratory data, or supply-chain data is highly desirable for manufacturing-focused programs.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Ability to translate business problems into data science use cases
Strong stakeholder-management and consulting skills
Excellent documentation and presentation skills
Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to business stakeholders
Ability to independently lead data science workstreams
Experience mentoring junior data scientists

6+ years of Data Science and AI/ML experience with strong pharmaceutical/life sciences domain knowledge and hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, statistical modelling, machine learning, predictive analytics, data engineering concepts, and productionizing analytical solutions. Job Title Lead Data Scientist – Manager
Job Description
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
We are looking for a hands-on Data Scientist to develop analytical and machine learning solutions used by petroleum, drilling, production, process and reliability engineers. You will work with operational and engineering data to diagnose performance, predict outcomes and support better operating decisions across upstream and downstream assets.
Role Details
Key responsibilities include :
Upstream data science
Develop analytical solutions for well-performance surveillance, production forecasting, artificial-lift diagnostics and equipment-health monitoring.
Analyse drilling data to identify operating states, evaluate rate-of-penetration performance and detect patterns associated with dysfunctions or non-productive time.
Work with production rates, well tests, pressure and temperature measurements, choke settings, lift-system parameters and intervention histories.
Distinguish measured, tested and allocated production, accounting for shut-ins, interventions and operating-strategy changes.
Support well-log and reservoir-related modelling with geoscience and reservoir specialists where relevant.
Downstream data science
Develop inferential models and soft sensors for product quality, unit yields and process performance.
Analyse heat-exchanger fouling, rotating-equipment condition, catalyst-performance trends, and energy or utility consumption.
Work with process historians, laboratory systems, online analyzers, crude assays, maintenance records and simulation outputs.
Align laboratory results with sample time and process residence time, distinguishing steady operation from start-ups, shutdowns, and grade or feedstock changes.
Support blending, process optimization and planning using predictive models and appropriately constrained analytical methods.
Model development and technical delivery
Define engineering objectives, prediction horizons, target variables, operating boundaries and acceptance criteria with domain specialists.
Assess data quality, sampling bias, confounding, missing measurements, lineage and suitability; perform exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing and uncertainty estimation.
Engineer domain-informed features and develop statistical, machine learning and time-series models for regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly and change-point detection.
Establish defensible baselines and time-aware or grouped validation, preventing leakage and addressing autocorrelation, non-stationarity, imbalance, sparse labels and changing conditions.
Evaluate using application-relevant measures, apply explainability and uncertainty methods, and use deep learning only where justified against simpler alternatives.
Build reproducible training and inference pipelines; track experiments and monitor data quality, drift, predictive performance and training-serving consistency.
Document assumptions, applicability limits, validation and retraining triggers; review code and guide other data scientists.
Expected technical stack
Strong hands-on Python and SQL.
Practical experience with pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, statistical modelling libraries and at least one gradient-boosting framework.
Experience with version control, automated testing, experiment tracking, model registries, deployment workflows and model monitoring.
Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow where deep learning is appropriate.
Must Have Qualifications & Experience
A degree in petroleum, chemical, mechanical or another relevant engineering discipline, statistics, mathematics, computer science or data science.
Demonstrated hands-on delivery of Oil & Gas analytical solutions, with strong experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain and working understanding of the other.
Strong foundations in statistics, regression, classification, time-series analysis, feature engineering, model evaluation and uncertainty estimation.
Experience with irregular sampling, missing measurements, limited failure labels, changing operating conditions and multiple operational regimes.
Evidence of personal contribution across data assessment, development, deployment and operational monitoring.
Experience leading or reviewing data scientists’ technical work and collaborating with engineering and technology teams.
Good to Have
Experience delivering analytical solutions across both upstream and downstream environments.
Specialist depth in signal processing, reliability modelling, constrained optimization, subsurface analytics, or hybrid engineering and ML methods.
Familiarity with well-data formats, industrial historians, laboratory systems and engineering simulators.
Experience with cloud ML platforms or edge inference.
Experience applying NLP, retrieval-augmented generation or agentic workflows to engineering information and analytical tools.

Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.
What We Look For
A Data Scientist who can walk through a real industrial modelling problem and clearly explain the data, engineering assumptions, baseline, feature design, validation, deployment behaviour, business relevance and model limitations, while evidencing personal technical contribution and ability to lead others.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
Role Details
Key responsibilities include :
Scientific formulation and advanced modelling
Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.
Upstream applications
Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.
Downstream applications
Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.
Model assurance and generalization
Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.
Technical leadership and scalable delivery
Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.
Must Have Qualifications & Experience
A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.
Good to Have
Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.
What We Offer
Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.

Applied Optimisation Scientist (Lead / Senior Level)
Career Family
Applied Optimization & Advanced Analytics
Role Type
Full Time
Experience: 8–12+ years
The Opportunity
We are looking for a highly skilled Applied Optimisation Scientist to design, extend, and validate large-scale mathematical optimisation models supporting strategic mine planning and optimisation platforms. This role focuses on solving complex, high-impact planning problems using advanced optimisation techniques to drive long-term operational and investment decisions. You will work at the intersection of mathematical modelling, software engineering, and domain-specific problem-solving, contributing to mission-critical systems that directly influence business performance. The role requires strong expertise in linear and mixed-integer optimisation, hands-on solver experience, and the ability to translate real-world constraints into scalable optimisation solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
Optimisation Model Development
Develop and maintain large-scale LP/MIP optimisation models for mine planning and scheduling.
Design and implement constraints including capacity, sequencing, blending, cost optimisation, and boundary conditions.
Support advanced optimisation workflows such as Direct Block Scheduling (DBS).
Continuously improve model structure and performance for production-grade deployments.
Solver Integration & Performance
Integrate and configure optimisation solvers such as Gurobi, Maroma, and AMPL.
Ensure high performance, scalability, and numerical stability of models.
Diagnose and resolve infeasible solutions, performance bottlenecks, and instability issues.
Optimize solver parameters and execution strategies for efficiency.
Validation & Quality Assurance
Validate optimisation outputs through rigorous testing, cross-validation, and alternate formulations.
Ensure correctness, reliability, and consistency of outputs.
Take ownership of solution quality and defend results with strong analytical reasoning.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Collaborate with product teams, engineers, and domain experts to translate business problems into mathematical models.
Communicate optimisation assumptions, trade-offs, and outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support decision-making by providing insights derived from optimisation models.
Required Skills
Strong background in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, and optimisation techniques.
Proven experience in Linear Programming (LP) and Mixed Integer Programming (MIP).
Hands-on experience with Gurobi, Maroma, and AMPL (mandatory).
Experience with additional solvers such as CPLEX or Xpress is advantageous.
Strong Python programming skills for model development, integration, and testing.
Experience handling large-scale, performance-critical datasets.
Solid understanding of optimisation model performance tuning and stability considerations.
Preferred Skills & Experience
Experience in mine planning, supply chain optimisation, or heavy industry use cases.
Exposure to graph-based optimisation and network flow models.
Familiarity with enterprise-scale optimisation systems.
Working knowledge of C# / .NET (preferred).
Core Technology Stack
Optimisation Solvers: Gurobi, Maroma, AMPL
Methods: Linear Programming, Mixed Integer Programming, Network Flow Optimisation, Constraint Modelling
Programming: Python, AMPL, C#/.NET (preferred)
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
Ability to solve complex real-world optimisation challenges
Ownership mindset with strong attention to detail
Effective communication and stakeholder engagement
Ability to balance model accuracy with computational efficiency
Education
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in operations research, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
What We Offer
We offer an opportunity to work on high-impact optimisation problems in a collaborative and innovation-driven environment. You will gain exposure to complex industrial use cases, cutting-edge optimisation techniques, and enterprise-scale systems. We foster continuous learning, encourage technical excellence, and provide opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Unser Bereich Financial Services fokussiert sich auf Finanzdienstleistungen und unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen und Asset Manager dabei, in einer sich stets verändernden und schnelllebigen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.
Deine Aufgaben
Im Umfeld bilanzieller, regulatorischer und marktbezogener Anforderungen arbeiten in dem Bereich Financial Accounting Advisory Services interdisziplinäre Teams, die ganzheitlich maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für unsere Mandant:innen entwickeln. Du verstärkst uns in Frankfurt/Main mit bilanzieller, aufsichtsrechtlicher und/oder quantitativer Expertise, um innovative Ideen für unsere Mandant:innen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
Du berätst und prüfst gemeinsam mit quantitativ ausgebildeten Kolleg:innen nationale sowie internationale Unternehmen des Finanzsektors.
Du entwickelst kreative Lösungen zur Nutzung unausgeschöpfter Datenpotenziale, unter anderem im Bereich Risk Analytics (z. B. Automatisierung, Datenvisualisierung und Einsatz von Machine Learning).
Du entwickelst globale cloudbasierte Services für quantitative Fragestellungen, zum Beispiel für die Preisbewertung und Analyse großer Portfolios von Finanzinstrumenten.
Du modellierst und automatisiert komplexe betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge mit geeigneten Daten- und Analysemethoden.
Du begleitest Rechnungswesen und Risikomanagement bei der datengetriebenen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Prozesse und Modelle.
Dein Skillset
Du hast ein Studium mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt, zum Beispiel in Mathematik, Statistik, Physik oder Informatik, erfolgreich abgeschlossen und verfügst über Erfahrung in Datenanalyse, ETL-Prozessen, Data Mining, maschinellem Lernen oder Datenvisualisierung.
Du beherrscht mindestens eine Programmiersprache, zum Beispiel Python, R, C#, Java oder JavaScript, oder ein Datenbanksystem wie SQL, SAS oder MongoDB sicher.
Du hast durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung gesammelt. Auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizierst du jeweils mindestens auf C1-Niveau.
Dein Mindset
Agil : Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
Neugierig : Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
Teamorientiert : Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits .

Weitere Informationen zu Financial Services findest du hier .
Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor .

Participate in model selection, feature design, embedding strategy, and prompt frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Participate in the design and build robust data pipelines that are scalable, reproducible, and versioned.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Outstanding academic performance, with a bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
Familiarity with multi-modal agent frameworks (LangChain, Haystack, RAG pipelines).
Knowledge in vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma), retrieval systems, and LLM fine-tuning.
Strong understanding of real-world structured data merging, schema linking, and model evaluation at scale.
Strong understanding of ML workflow including ingesting, analyzing, transforming data, and evaluating results to make meaningful predictions.
Fluency in Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, with ability to architect APIs around ML models.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining ML models, frameworks, and pipelines.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex, technical concepts and progress, methodologies, solutioning, and results to business and client stakeholders.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary.
